'''Evar Orllincus''' was a [[General/Legends|General]] serving in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Orllincus was on [[Prishella III]] inspecting the garrisons, and was the target of an [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] operation tasked with capturing the general.<ref name="ROE" />
